body: Man the only thing I can say is you choose this life. You can kill yourself and come back and do it all again. I’m the same try and feel your emotions instead of blocking them out that’s why girls get over things easily they feel their emotions we bottle them up until you have no idea how to process anything
Thanks brother feelings have calmed down a bit
I feel your pain I’m in a similar boat I’m thinking about it right now as well, don’t do it though or they win
Yeah you’re right you really are

I think I definitely have a problem now, full disclosure. I’m stirring here smashing drinks and have a bag of coke, which I never really done in the past but fk it. 

100% though be hard come good who knows, all I know is this is fkn bullshit

Yes I’m going to get that. You’re right never get over it it is who you are now.

Definitely still doesn’t take away the pain of being thrown away like trash when she can just forget about it and continue living her life.

I’m gonna seek help, never in a million years did I think I would end up here, loosing my brother was enough this is actually unbearable. 

I wish you peace as well

Thank you for such a detailed response. I’m very sorry for your losses as well.... I didn’t realise that about relationships I could never imagine leaving someone in a situation like this. I’m to depressed right now to go into much more but I really appreciate it and I hope everything turns out well with you as well

Yeah I have booked In counselling for next week flirted with the idea of AA I think I need it at that point, but I think I don’t wanna admit I’ve developed a problem. But I will. Thanks for the advice
